steps.tx: **21-hydroxylase deficiency** is the common form of congenital adrenal hyperplasia. Cortisol is low, ACTH is high, and adrenal androgens are high. Salt-wasting disease is also missing aldosterone. A **17-hydroxyprogesterone** often above 10000 ng/dL in classic disease makes the diagnosis. Cortisol and aldosterone are lost, and ACTH drives androgen production.

vis.alt: Adrenal cortex block with zona glomerulosa labelled aldosterone, fasciculata cortisol, reticularis androgens, and medulla catecholamines.
vis.caption: Zona glomerulosa is labelled aldosterone, zona fasciculata cortisol, and zona reticularis adrenal androgens. The medulla is catecholamines. The drawing does not show the enzyme. In 21-hydroxylase deficiency the cortisol and aldosterone layers fail. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Nonclassic** 21-hydroxylase deficiency can imitate **polycystic ovary syndrome**. A cosyntropin-stimulated **17-hydroxyprogesterone** above 1000 ng/dL supports nonclassic disease. Measure it when hyperandrogenism is atypical, starts early, or runs in the family. A routine PCOS label is the wrong end point if the onset was in childhood or a sibling is affected.

left.title: Nonclassic 21-hydroxylase deficiency
points: Onset may be early or familial

right.title: Ordinary polycystic ovary syndrome
points: Still exclude the enzyme if the story is atypical

steps.tx: A virilized newborn needs an urgent **17-hydroxyprogesterone**, electrolytes, and a karyotype. **Salt-wasting** crisis, with hyponatremia, **hyperkalemia**, and shock, typically appears in the first 1 to 4 weeks, not on the first day of life. A normal sodium on day 1 does not exclude salt-wasting disease. The electrolytes are watched through the first month.

vis.alt: Spectrum of virilised female external genitalia with clitoromegaly and labial fusion.
vis.caption: External virilisation in a 46,XX infant: clitoromegaly and labial fusion. The drawing is the genital appearance. It does not show the electrolyte crisis, which comes in the first 1 to 4 weeks rather than on day 1. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: Growing children with classic disease are treated with **hydrocortisone**, not with a long-acting glucocorticoid, because **dexamethasone** suppresses growth. **Fludrocortisone** and sodium chloride supplements are added in the salt-wasting form. Doses are raised for illness. Hydrocortisone is short-acting, so growth is less suppressed than it is on dexamethasone.

steps.tx: **11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency** causes virilization plus **hypertension** and hypokalemia, because **11-deoxycortisol** and deoxycorticosterone build up. 17-hydroxyprogesterone can be mildly high, but 11-deoxycortisol is the marker that separates this block from 21-hydroxylase deficiency. The blood pressure is high, which is the opposite of salt-wasting 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

right.title: 21-hydroxylase deficiency
points: Aldosterone is missing in the salt-wasting form

steps.tx: **17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency** blocks sex-steroid and cortisol synthesis and raises **deoxycorticosterone**. The picture is hypertension, **hypokalemia**, and absent puberty. A 46,XY infant looks undervirilized, or a 46,XX adolescent does not develop secondary sexual characteristics. Sex steroids are low, which separates this block from 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

steps.tx: **3-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase** deficiency raises **DHEA** and can cause ambiguous genitalia in both a 46,XX infant and a 46,XY infant. Severe disease also causes salt wasting. This block is rare compared with 21-hydroxylase deficiency. Both genetic sexes can look ambiguous, unlike classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency in a 46,XY infant, who is usually virilized.

right.title: 21-hydroxylase deficiency
points: This is the common enzyme block

steps.tx: Prenatal **dexamethasone**, given to prevent virilization of an affected female fetus, is not routine care. Unaffected fetuses are exposed for an uncertain benefit. **Prenatal** genetic counseling is the standard, and empiric early steroid is not. Do not start dexamethasone in every at-risk pregnancy before the fetus is known to be an affected 46,XX infant.

An uncertain benefit against a real steroid exposure

right.title: Standard care
points: Steroid only in a defined protocol if it is used at all
Postnatal electrolytes and 17-hydroxyprogesterone still come first
